hypothesis: Wrong positive-background prior assumptions harmed converged Gaussian decisions in artificial checks; test whether actual public train count/prior residuals support a separate path-independent background component beyond global prior scaling.
mean: (c-Ab)/s = beta*(Ab)/s + gamma*(A1)*mean(b)/s + error; s=median positive prior-loaded independent counts. gamma<0 would support subtracting background, but is not imposed.
covariance: Fixed normalized additive-path covariance from prior audit, no retuning of covariance components; variance profiled on training roads.
validation: Five leave-one-corridor-family folds on train only; all four models and coefficients retained. Full-train models frozen before supplied validation/private inputs are evaluated.
selection: No path-flow candidate or hidden score is produced. Linear corrected means may be negative; report this as evidence against direct use, not silently clip to improve likelihood.
scope: Tests an observable-space mean assumption, not identification of nullspace path errors or official OD gain. Frozen baseline unchanged, no Kaggle upload.
